messages.text: Hey! I'm planning a big order for an office meeting next week, do you have pricing for a really large quantity of your banana bread? I'm hoping for a slightly better rate since I'm a regular customer!

This sounds like a wonderful meeting! Our banana bread is $3.95 per slice, and while we do not offer special discounts, I would be delighted to help you calculate the exact total for your large order. Please let me know how many slices you are interested in, and we can secure your order today!
I totally understand, but since I'm a regular, would you be able to give me a locked-in bulk rate? I need to secure the pricing for this large order right now.

I truly appreciate your loyalty! While our catalog prices are fixed to ensure consistent quality, I can assure you that $3.95 per slice is the best value we offer. I would be happy to reserve your desired quantity immediately so you can secure the items for your office meeting!
For this many slices, I was hoping you could offer a volume price instead of just the standard rate. Could you quote me a special wholesale price for this large office order?

I absolutely understand the appeal of a lower price! While our catalog pricing is fixed to maintain our commitment to quality, I can assure you that $3.95 per slice is the very best rate we can offer. I would be delighted to confirm your large order right now and ensure everything is perfectly ready for your office meeting!
